framework: research-only translation of institutional underwriting disciplines into a China public-market process; no security, product, investor or live implementation is approved

strategy_controls.current_state: No user account, capital amount, suitability, named security or product has been supplied. This memo is a process framework only.
strategy_controls.research_universe_policy: Open public-market research universe; any future direct equity must enter through an issuer-specific dossier and may not be treated as a current allocation.
strategy_controls.fallback_policy: When evidence, suitability, liquidity or risk-budget requirements fail, remain in protected liquidity; do not substitute yield, leverage or a less-liquid asset.
strategy_controls.execution_eligibility_policy: Every current market-traded item is q=0 until named-item, account, tax, settlement, liquidity and risk-budget controls have been independently completed.
strategy_controls.performance_measurement: No return objective is claimed. Any later strategy evaluation must be point-in-time, net of realistic costs/taxes, and show both TWRR and investor MWRR/XIRR where external flows occur.

pass_conditions: Each material institutional and China-market claim resolves to an archived official source or is explicitly qualified.
The memo separates manager-process description from proof of transferable return generation.
All non-transferable strategies—control, LBO, private origination, insider access and institutional insurance/ALM—are reader-facing exclusions.
The personal analogue has clear public-information underwriting, position-risk, liquidity, monitoring and invalidation gates.
No named security, target price, product suitability result or live allocation is implied.
XeLaTeX source, PDF, text extraction, provenance, visual review and R0–R4 lifecycle reconcile.
The only permitted sign-off is a research-framework pass with implementation not approved and q=0.
downgrade_path: research framework -> educational evidence memo / watchlist process only; never a personalised recommendation or live portfolio approval without investor inputs and named-item evidence
